main.CAPABILITY.description: Two SMs, 32 instruction slots and eight-word TX/RX FIFOs.

main.ROUTABLE_MASK.description: GPIO0..31 routable mask on the fully integrated Tiny.

main.CLOCK_HZ.description: Actual PCLK rate used by both SMs; read again after an RCU change.

main.FLAG_SET.description: Set selected shared flags; hardware set wins concurrent clears.

main.FLAG_CLEAR.description: Clear selected shared flags without changing unselected flags.

main.IRQ_STATUS.description: Enabled sticky events, shared flags and FIFO watermark levels.

main.IRQ_ENABLE.description: Global enable mask for the PIO-lite interrupt sources.

main.TX_BIND.description: TX SM, central-DMA channel and binding enable; changes require quiescence.

main.RX_BIND.description: RX SM, central-DMA channel and binding enable; changes require quiescence.

main.TRANSPORT_STATUS.description: TX/RX job ownership, held beats and closing state.

main.IMEM_VALID.description: Instruction slots valid for START; loading publishes only validated words.

main.OWNED_MASK.description: Actual GPIO USER_SELECT ownership, including acquisition handoff.

main.START.description: Atomically start selected DISABLED SMs after full configuration validation.
fields: SM0/SM1 start mask; zero is a no-op.

main.PAUSE.description: Pause selected RUNNING SMs while retaining execution and FIFO phase.

main.RESUME.description: Resume selected PAUSED SMs without START reinitialization.

main.DISABLE.description: Disable selected SMs only when associated transport is inactive.

main.ABORT.description: Stop side effects and close selected SM transport for explicit recovery.

main.SM_RESET.description: Reset drained selected SM endpoints while retaining claims and configuration.

main.BLOCK_RESET.description: Reset block-local state only when all SMs, bindings, transport and USER ownership are idle.

sm.STATUS.description: Current SM lifecycle, stall cause and last nonblocking FIFO failure.

sm.CONFIG.description: Autopull/autopush, shift directions and test-pin enable.

sm.PROGRAM.description: Absolute IMEM base, program length and entry.

sm.WRAP.description: Inclusive wrap bottom/top inside the loaded program region.

sm.IN_PINS.description: GPIO input window base and width; zero disables it.

sm.OUT_PINS.description: GPIO output window base and width; zero disables it.

sm.SET_PINS.description: GPIO SET window base and width, up to eight pins.

sm.OUTPUT_MASK.description: Exclusive SM output authorization; SMs cannot overlap outputs.

sm.INITIAL_VALUE.description: GPIO-aligned START output levels; non-output bits must be zero.

sm.INITIAL_OE.description: GPIO-aligned START output enables; non-output bits must be zero.

sm.INITIAL_XY.description: Initial 16-bit X and Y values loaded by START.

sm.TXDATA.description: Push one CPU word when the TX FIFO has space and is not DMA-owned.

sm.RXDATA.description: Pop one CPU word when RX data exists and the FIFO is not DMA-owned.

sm.EVENTS.description: Sticky HALT/ABORT/FAULT/stall/FIFO-failure events; hardware set wins W1C.

sm.FAULT.description: First fault code and PC, retained until SM or block reset.

sm.TICK_COUNT.description: Saturating count of unpaused execution ticks, including stalls and delays.

sm.TX_STALL_COUNT.description: Saturating count of execution ticks stalled for TX.

sm.RX_STALL_COUNT.description: Saturating count of execution ticks stalled for RX.

sm.RETIRED_COUNT.description: Saturating count of successfully committed instructions.

sm.EXEC_PHASE.description: Divider edges and delay ticks remaining.
